watches.name: MING × Massena LAB 57.09 Secret Honey
watches.description: The original MING x Massena LAB 17.09, released in two dial variants, referenced the “honeycomb” pattern found in highly collectible, vintage wristwatch dials from the mid-20 th century. The 17.09 Honey paired stainless steel with a dial adorned with a hexagonal take on that mid-century design, rendered in a warm honey tone. The 17.09 Black took the same idea somewhere darker. The new 57.09 Secret Honey combines both palettes in one watch, replacing the literal honeycomb pattern with a more elusive interpretation, then sets it all in motion, and the honey hue is revealed only as the disks rotate. A dark brown, lacquered, and circular-brushed base dial sits beneath three rotating sapphire disks with anti-reflective coatings. The disks complete one rotation every 24 hours, 12 hours, and 60 minutes, respectively. Each disk has its own color and opening pattern, with select elements coated in orange- emitting Super-LumiNova or white-emitting MING Polar White. As the apertures overlap, they create a continuously shifting interference pattern that MING calls dynamic guilloché . The 12-hour and 60-minute disks carry the honey-colored hour and minute indications, which glow orange thanks to Super-LumiNova. Above them, the indices and the MING and Massena LAB logos are engraved into the box-style top sapphire crystal and filled with MING Polar White, creating a second luminous layer. The display never stops moving, but it only looks like it’s drenched in neon after dark. The grade-5 titanium case uses MING’s fifth-generation design language. It measures 40mm in diameter, 10.17mm thick, and 47.8mm from lug-to-lug, with 100 meters of water resistance. The scale and shape of the case, especially the large dial and relatively thin bezel, allude to both our original 17.09 collaboration and a few of William’s favorite vintage watches. And then there are the lugs. We’ve upped the ante on a case that already pushes the envelope. For the first time at MING, each step utilizes a different color. The outermost step remains natural titanium. The middle step is coated in TiN to recall yellow gold, while the innermost step is coated in TiSiN to reference rose gold. The tri-tone lugs mirror the dial’s shifting black-and-honey palette, uniting the case and dial. The watch is powered by the self-winding Sellita for MING 330.M2, visible through the sapphire crystal exhibition caseback. It offers approximately 50 hours of power reserve and runs at 4 Hz, or 28,800 vibrations per hour. The movement features skeletonized bridges with brushed finishing and an anthracite coating, set over a matching anthracite-coated baseplate. The 57.09 Secret Honey is delivered with two straps: a vachetta-colored goat leather strap by Jean Rousseau Paris for MING and a black MING FKM rubber strap. Each strap is fitted with a stainless-steel flying-blade tuck buckle with micro-adjustment. The MING × Massena LAB 57.09 Secret Honey will be produced in a limited edition of 125 examples and is priced at CHF 7,250, excluding import duties and taxes. Orders will open exclusively through www.ming.watch on 15 October 2026 at 1:00 PM GMT. The Secret Honey will be presented publicly during WatchTime New York, where MING and Massena LAB will exhibit from 16 to 18 October 2026.

watches.name: Tokiograph by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès
watches.description: Massena LAB is proud to announce Tokiograph by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès, a limited edition of 39 pieces, created to celebrate Massena LAB’s first appearance in Japan at Tokyo Watch Week 2026. A wristwatch with a contemplative, grey dial with white and red lacquer details, the Tokiograph by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès, is powered by a manual-winding movement designed by Massena LAB in collaboration with the independent watchmaker Raúl Pagès, all housed in a 38.5mm stainless steel case. The name “Tokiograph” is first a nod to the city of Tokyo, where Massena LAB will be making its debut in Japan at Tokyo Watch Week from October 9 - 12, 2026. However, the name holds a double meaning: in Japanese, “ toki ” (時) means “time,” while “graph”, is derived from the Greek “ graphein” (γράφειν), meaning “to write” or “to record.” The Tokiograph is the spiritual successor to the Noctograph by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès, which has been recently nominated at the 2026 Grand Prix d’Horlogerie de Genève , where it is competing in the Petite Aiguille category. The Tokiograph, building upon the design language of the Noctograph, is adorned with a dial with an austere, grey dial plate which has been vertically brushed and is devoid of any markings, apart from a subtle signature reading “Massena” at 4 o’clock. Depending on the light, the tone of the dial shifts gently from steel to charcoal, captivating the eye. The subsidiary seconds dial is slightly recessed and is lacquered in white and red with dark charcoal markings, creating a dimensional, textural, and tonal contrast with the brushed grey dial. Like the Noctograph before it, the Tokiograph melds contemporary minimalism with classic and historical references favored by William Massena and Massena LAB. Surrounding the dark grey dial is a chapter ring which is rhodium-plated and radially brushed. This outer section is marked with a fine, dark charcoal railroad track showing the hours and minutes, mirroring a similar motif on the small seconds dial. A pair of polished feuille hands, in stainless steel, float above the surface in contrast to the brushed dial, casting a gentle reflection. Inspired by dress watches of the 1930s to the 1950s, the classic silhouette of the hands contrasts harmoniously with the minimalism of the dial, blending modernism with classicism. The Tokiograph by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès is powered by the manual winding caliber M660, our Swiss-made movement with extensive hand finishing. Designed by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès, the architecture of the movement is dominated by a broad plate with fine Côtes de Genève finishing and hand-chamfered plates and bridges. The movement bears Raúl’s signature in the form of a delicate poinçon , tucked behind the caliber’s balance wheel between overlapping circles of perlage finishing, in the shape of his acclaimed tortoise automaton. While Raúl Pagès oversees and directs the production of the movement, production is entrusted to a select team of Swiss watchmakers, and he does not engage directly in the production of the movement as he would do in the creation of his own pieces. The Tokiograph is housed in a 316L stainless steel case measuring 38.5mm in diameter whose silhouette is inspired by watches of the 1940s and 50s. Its case combines both polished and brushed surfaces and is fitted with a grey calfskin strap, which is handmade in Italy and paired with a stainless steel Massena LAB buckle. JPY 1,800,000 excluding tax. (JPY 1,980,000 including 10% Japanese consumption tax).

watches.name: Atelier Wen x Massena LAB Inflection Shuò (Rose Gold)
watches.description: Massena LAB is proud to launch the Atelier Wen x Massena LAB Inflection Shuò, a limited edition of 50 pieces built around two hand-finished, Swiss-made dials featuring intricate, hand tremblage . The limited-edition is split between two variants: Rose Gold and White Gold. Both are housed in a 99.9% tantalum case and integrated bracelet. The collaboration takes the name 'Shuò,' from the Chinese character 烁, which can be translated as 'sparkling,' or 'radiant,' poetically evoking the shimmering, reflective qualities of hand tremblage on its dial. The technique behind this subtle finishing, however, is anything but straightforward. The dials for both variants are first crafted from solid 18k gold, with a base plate finished with one of the rarest and most demanding decorative crafts in watchmaking: hand tremblage . The technique is executed entirely by hand by engraving specialist Coralie Mercier on behalf of GT Cadrans, who pushes a graver across the 18k gold surface while continuously oscillating the dial, slowly transforming its texture into thousands of tiny, irregular facets. A time-consuming and unforgiving process, a single mistake can ruin an entire dial. On top of this main dial plate is a radially brushed sector of rose gold. Arranged in a California-dial-inspired layout, another design element inspired by the exchange between East and West at the heart of this collaboration, the hour sector combines hand-engraved, custom serif Arabic numerals for hours 10 through 2, with hand-calligraphed Chinese numerals commissioned by Atelier Wen for hours 4 to 8. The outer sector ring is finished with more hand tremblage and framed by a finely engraved huiwen border, a classic Chinese decorative motif named for its resemblance to the Chinese character 回. Both the engraved, custom, Arabic numerals, and the hand-calligraphed Chinese numerals are blue-filled to match the blued-steel hour, minute, and second hands hovering above the hand-finished dial. At 12 o’clock, the dial is signed “Atelier Wen”, also in blue, while “Massena” is found near 6 o’clock in white gold, subtly marking the collaboration. In contrast to the inherent warmth of the gold dial: the cold blue hue of a 99.9% tantalum case and its integrated bracelet. Notoriously difficult metal to work, and harder yet to finish, tantalum is prized not just for its inky blue undertones but instead for its density, weight, anti-corrosive properties. The difficulty of working with tantalum is only heightened by the design language of the Atelier Wen x Massena LAB Inflection Shuò, whose 40mm tantalum case and bracelet embrace an all-curved architecture, which is inspired by Chinese architectural forms and features almost no flat planes whatsoever in its construction. A concave bezel and ridged midcase lend further depth and dimension to the case, while the bracelet's curved links play brushed and mirror-polished surfaces against one another. External links are finished with strong vertical brushing, middle links mirror-polished, and chamfers polished to a concave finish throughout. The case is water-resistant to 100m and features a screw-down crown in rose gold. The Atelier Wen x Massena LAB Inflection Shuò is powered by a customized, self-winding caliber GP03300 from Girard-Perregaux, one of Switzerland's oldest and most storied manufactures of haute horlogerie . The curved, sweeping lines of the bridges take their inspiration from motifs of wind found in historical Chinese paintings, a symbolic contrast between lightness and the immense weight of tantalum itself. The bridges are ruthenium-plated and finished with dramatic anglage , sharp exterior angles, and laser-etched waved côtes that emanate radially from the movement's center, complemented by black-polished screws and a similarly wind-inspired rotor, plated in 5N rose gold. watches.name: Petrichor by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès
watches.description: Massena LAB is proud to partner with the Swiss Institute for the second tiem as an official sponsor of the TimeForArt auction in partnership with Phillips in Association with Bacs & Russo. For the 2024 installment, Massena LAB will contribute “Petrichor”, a pièce unique by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès. Measuring 38.5mm in diameter, the stainless steel timepiece features a harmonious dial in a warm sable tone with a sunburst finish, which shifts in the light from umber to sandstone.; Petrichor is a term which describes the singular, pleasant, and nostalgic scent that emerges when rain falls on dry soil, originating from the Greek words “petra,” for stone, and “ichor,” the divine blood of the gods in Greek mythology. Petrichor is powered by a proprietary caliber, the manual-wound M690, which was designed for Massena LAB by the Swiss independent watchmaker, Raúl Pagès. The movement, whose finishing features a high-level of hand decoration, is visible through an exhibition case back. Petrichor is a pièce unique, conceived and created for the Swiss Institutes’ “Time for Art” auction. The watch was not commercialized or reproduced.

watches.name: Studio Underd0g x Massena LAB Champagne & Caviar
watches.description: The Studio Underd0g x Massena LAB 03SERIES Champagne & Caviar is a limited-edition monopusher chronograph which celebrates all things extraordinary and excessive, with a design that pairs the subtle shimmer of champagne tones with the inky richness of caviar. By employing modern machining techniques, the oversized "big-eye" sub-dial at three o'clock has been artfully reimagined to resemble a (generously portioned) pot of caviar, a subtle yet striking detail that defines the design. The varied size of the sub-dials is visually offset by the co-branding, allowing the chronograph seconds hand to pass through uninterrupted. Idiosyncratic, yet balanced. A keen eye will notice the distinct silhouette of a champagne bottle at the base of the chronograph hand, sweeping smoothly over the shimmering champagne dial. Housed within the three-part case construction —and visible through its exhibition caseback —is the Swiss Sellita SW510 M. This monopusher, hand-winding calibre beats at 28,800 vph (4 Hz); features 63 hours of power reserve; and a custom Côte de Genève , ruthenium-anthracite-finished bridge exclusively made for Studio Underd0g. Cased in 316L stainless steel measuring 38.5mm, with a lug-to-lug measurement of only 44.5mm, the Studio Underd0g x Massena LAB 03SERIES Champagne & Caviar is flattering to a variety of wrist sizes. On the dial side, the watch is fitted with a double-domed sapphire crystal, while the exhibition caseback is fitted with a flat, box sapphire crystal. The Studio Underd0g x Massena LAB 03SERIES Champagne & Caviar, limited to only 200 pieces, is priced at £1,750 / $2,200 / €1,800 and will be offered exclusively via underd0g.com from 3pm GMT on November 11, 2025 . Orders will be processed and shipped based on order number (first come, first served basis). Sign up here, using the "inquire" button, to be notified at launch.

watches.name: Angelus Chronographe Télémètre Massena LAB
watches.description: We are proud to introduce the Angelus Chronographe Télémètre Massena LAB, a monopusher chronograph with a grained, black dial and an elegant case crafted from 18k gold and an exemplary movement by a watchmaker renowned for creating highly technical chronographs, Angelus. With a diameter of 37 mm and a thickness of only 9.25 mm, the Chronographe Télémètre is one of the most compact of the contemporary Angelus models. True to the spirit of historic Angelus chronographs, the watch features a classically styled case in 18k yellow gold (3N) with a slim bezel for maximum dial surface area and legibility. The Chronographe Télémètre features a black, grained, sunk dial set under a box sapphire crystal. Its black color, inspired by a vintage Angelus chronograph from William Massena's collection, is rare among Angelus watches. The grained dial reduces the effects of glare while providing textural contrast to its two radially grooved subsidiary dials: small seconds at 9 o'clock and a 30-minute counter at 3 o'clock. Gold-plated indices and Arabic numerals are polished, providing clear contrast to the matte black dial. Powering the timepiece is an exemplary movement: the manual-winding Angelus caliber A5000. Manufactured in-house, the caliber uses only a single pusher — cleverly integrated into the crown — to start, stop, and reset the chronograph. The finely crafted movement measures 24 mm in diameter and just 4.2 mm in thickness, ideal proportions for a 37 mm case. The movement utilizes a Swiss-lever escapement with a balance wheel oscillating at 21,600 vibrations per hour (3 Hz), ensuring optimal precision. The caliber A5000 is distinguished by its exemplary finishing: the elements of the mainplate and bridges are carefully beveled and finished with 3N gold. The functional components of the chronograph are palladium-coated for both performance and visual contrast. The levers, return mechanisms, and hammers are crafted from stainless steel and are finely brushed to highlight their form. Last, the movement features polished screws and circularly grained gear wheels to add visual texture and depth. Price upon request.

watches.name: UNIMATIC U4S-T-SPW
watches.description: UNIMATIC and Massena LAB are proud to present the third and final chapter of their NASA Space Exploration trilogy: The Modello Quattro U4S‑T‑SPW. Crafted in Italy from lightweight titanium with a special Cerakote ™ H140 bright‑white coating, the 40mm case houses a genuine meteorite dial. Each dial is cut from a fragment of an ancient iron‑nickel meteorite, a material forged in the vacuum of space over millions of years, traveling through the solar system before falling to Earth, where it was eventually recovered and meticulously prepared for horological use. Its distinctive surface reveals the Widmanstätten pattern, an interlacing crystalline structure that forms only during the slow cooling of molten metal at a rate of just a few degrees per million years. These intricate lines, created light‑years away from our planet, ensure that no two dials are ever alike. Each timepiece becomes a literal slice of cosmic history, carrying with it the story of its journey through time and space. Above the dial, the Super‑LumiNova® BG W9 markers and NASA "worm" logo are printed directly onto the 2.8mm flat sapphire crystal, creating a floating effect that adds depth and visual intrigue, giving the dial a distinct space‑inspired character. The release of the U4S‑T‑SPW follows two preceding collaborations with Massena LAB launched to celebrate NASA’s Artemis missions, the U1-SPG “NASA Artemis” and UT4-SPT “NASA Artemis II” limited editions. NASA’s upcoming missions, marking a renaissance of space exploration, will mark the first crewed return to the Moon since the Apollo program ended in the early 1970s. Looking ahead, these missions aim for a more ambitious (and historic) goal: sending the first astronauts to Mars. The U4S‑T‑SPW is built for professional performance with water resistance individually tested to 30 ATM (300m / 1000 ft). Its titanium case is paired with an 8mm screw‑down crown and a case back engraved with a detailed meteor comparison chart. Inside beats the Swiss‑made Sellita SW200‑1 b automatic movement, operating at 28,800 bph with a 38‑hour power reserve, 26 jewels, hacking seconds, and accuracy within ±12 seconds per day. Each watch is delivered on a white nylon keeper two‑piece quick‑release strap with a titanium Cerakote ™‑coated buckle, along with a cool‑gray TPU strap. Limited to just 60 pieces, the U4S‑T‑SPW will be offered exclusively at Geneva Watch Days 2025. Free U.S. shipping.

watches.name: Old Soul by Vianney Halter and Massena LAB
watches.description: Massena LAB is proud to partner with the legendary independent watchmaker Vianney Halter to create Old Soul, a limited-edition wristwatch that marries Halter's otherworldly vision and technical mastery with Massena LAB's deep reverence of horological history. For Old Soul, the "soul" in question is its movement: the heartbeat and life force of a watch but also its essence and individual character. After all, the soul is an immortal entity, meant to outlive the physical vessel that contains it. The development of Old Soul began with the discovery of cache of new old stock vintage movements from the celebrated watchmaker Minerva. This Minerva 17’22 caliber, first developed in the 1920s and used in pocket watches until 1942, has been reimagined and revived in 2025, transformed into an object that is neither past nor present. Old Soul features a multilayered dial with steampunk influences—a Vianney Halter calling card—as well as vintage and mid-century design inspiration from Massena LAB. Hours, minutes, and seconds appear on three separate registers: hours at three o'clock, seconds at 9 o'clock, and minutes along the outer chapter ring. Old Soul employs an ingenious mysterious minute disc system that creates the illusion of a minute hand orbiting in space and floating magically above the dial. Thanks to Halter's technical mastery, Old Soul's movement has been modified to incorporate the transparent minute disc used to achieve the mystery dial complication—marking the first time a vintage movement has been used in this way. Arabic numerals, rendered in Halter’s signature typeface, reinforce the watchmaker’s touch. Meanwhile, the chemin de fer , or railroad track styling on all three registers, recalls celebrated vintage watches from the late 19th and early 20th centuries. "Vianney Halter" and "Massena" are printed on the interior side of the sapphire crystal rather than directly onto the dial itself, accentuating the dial's three-dimensional design and casting a subtle, pleasing shadow across the main plate. A steampunk-inspired shield rests atop the sapphire crystal. Engraved with rounded lines to complement its hourglass shape, the shield is dotted with stainless steel studs that evoke the Halter aesthetic. Old Soul is housed in a 42mm stainless steel case with a stepped lug design that anchors the watch to vintage tradition. The case mixes polished and brushed surfaces for elegant contrast. The crown is dotted with functional studs that not only enhance the steampunk aesthetic but also improve tactility for easier use. The movement of Old Soul is on full display through sapphire glass with anti-reflective coating for excellent visibility. The original Minerva caliber 17'22, crafted entirely by hand, is hand-finished with elegant stripes of Cotes de Genève , anglage throughout its architecture, and black polish finishing. Its mainspring barrel is engraved with the signature of the original movement maker, Minerva. The movements are signed with a double emblem bearing the insignias of both Vianney Halter and Massena LAB. Limited edition of only 47 pieces. Price available upon request.

watches.name: UNIMATIC UT4-SPT "NASA ARTEMIS II"
watches.description: Modello Quattro UT4-SPT “NASA Artemis II”, a rugged, 40mm tool watch with a NASA-signed dial and a Cerakote™-coated stainless steel case in “NASA Artemis” burnt orange. The UT4-SPT is a purpose-built tool watch engineered to meet the rigorous demands of an active and adventurous lifestyle, incorporating the best features of both field watches and dive watches. Featuring a robust, reliable movement protected by an in-house designed 360° protection system, the UT4-SPT boasts 300 meters of water resistance. Tested to meet the military standard benchmark, the durability of the UT4-SPT echoes NASA’s engineering spirit : built for the extremes of space exploration and grounded in purposeful design. The U4T-SPT features a Cerakote™-coated case in the same distinctive burnt orange hue as NASA’s next-generation Space Launch System (SLS) heavy-lift rocket. Designed to withstand the harshest conditions, the SLS will power all upcoming Artemis missions, which aim to send the first crewed spacecraft to the Moon since the Apollo missions, which ended in the early 1970s. The watch features a dial signed with NASA’s red “worm” logo, the official NASA emblem from the 1970s until the early 1990s. Large plots of warm Super-LumiNova® mark each hour, ensuring optimal visibility in low light. The Cerakote™-clad case of the UT4-SPT features a fixed bezel, a screw-down crown, and a durable, nylon strap with a buckle clad in Cerakote™ –all in the same tone of burnt orange. Cerakote™ is a durable, anti-corrosive, ceramic-based coating, designed to protect against harsh environments and is widely used in the aerospace industry. The closed, stainless steel caseback of the UT4-SPT is the engraved emblem of the NASA Artemis program, which depicts the letter ‘A’ rising from the Earth into space. Each watch in this time-limited edition will be individually numbered. The watch is powered by a high beat-rate quartz movement, the Seiko VH31A. The movement features a sweeping seconds hand, 2 jewels, and a power reserve of approximately two years. Surrounding the movement is a 360° protection system, designed in-house by UNIMATIC to the highest standards. The watch has been tested in the U.S. MIL-STD-810, a military standard that evaluates the durability and ruggedness of equipment, first developed by the United States Department of Defense. Each watch is delivered in an orange UNIMATIC tough pouch, with a NASA Velcro patch, and a warranty card with a unique ID seal.

watches.name: UNIMATIC U1-SPG "NASA ARTEMIS"
watches.description: Massena LAB is proud to introduce the UNIMATIC Modello Uno U1-SPG, a limited-edition wristwatch with a NASA-signed dial, made to commemorate the NASA Artemis missions, which aim to send the first astronauts to the Moon since the Apollo missions of the 1960s and 1970s. A limited edition of only 99 pieces, the U1-SPG is a self-winding wristwatch with GMT function and a stainless steel case with Cerakote ™ coating. The Artemis II mission, scheduled for 2026, will mark the first crewed mission in the new Space Launch System (SLS) rocket, a next-generation heavy-lift rocket designed to carry astronauts to the moon and, eventually, Mars. The upcoming moon missions (Artemis II, III, and IV) will explore the uncharted lunar South Pole region, and will establish mankind's first permanent space station on the Moon’s surface. Proudly signed “NASA”, its dial is matte black with “Old Radium” Super-LumiNova® for excellent legibility. Its classic “worm” NASA emblem, 24-hour track and hands are all luminous, as well as the 60-minute rotating bezel. The case of the U1-SPG is crafted from 316L stainless steel which is then coated with Cerakote™, a durable, anti-corrosive, ceramic-based coating. Ideal for protection against harsh environments, and is widely used in the aerospace industry, the burnt orange Cerakote™ of the U1-SPG is inspired directly from the orange hue which covers NASA's new SLS rocket. The crown of the U1-SPG and its bezel are coated with deep charcoal Cerakote ™ , and the watch is fitted with a sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating on the interior side. The case of the U1-SPG measures 40mm with a 41.5mm bezel. The overall design aesthetic pays tribute to the bold vision of 1960s retrofuturism. In particular, the design is strongly influenced by Stanley Kubrick’s 1968 masterpiece 2001: A Space Odyssey . The film, which explores the wonders of future space travel, blends imagined advanced technology with a distinctly 20th-century perspective. On its closed, stainless steel case back is the engraved emblem of the NASA Artemis program, depicting the letter ‘A’ rising from the Earth to the Moon and all that lies beyond it. The Modello Uno U1-SPG is powered by the self-winding Seiko NH34A, with 24 jewels, a frequency of 21,600bph (3Hz), and 42 hours of power reserve. Each example is individually numbered and presented in a branded UNIMATIC x Massena LAB tough case, additional pair of nylon straps in black, an embroidered NASA patch, warranty card, and unique ID seal. Limit of one watch per household. Limited edition of 99. Free U.S. shipping.

On the front (pocket side) of the bag, nautical flags signal "Massena" and "Albishorn." watches.name: MB&F: The First Fifteen Years
watches.description: MB&F: The First Fifteen Years is the watch industry's first catalogue raisonné , a comprehensive and annotated listing of all the known works of an artist. In this case, the artist is the watchmaker MB&F. MB&F: The First Fifteen Years consists of over 300 pages, with thirty-seven chapters written by watch journalist Suzanne Wong and William Massena of Massena LAB. The MB&F Catalogue Raisonné contains information about every single timepiece produced from the years 2005 to 2020, including prototypes and pieces that were not officially announced before. The book documents all 160 product variations along with over 400 photographs and indicates details such as the model name, reference number, materials, years in production, and the exact quantity produced. The book will be published by both Editions de La Martinière and Abrams, in a first run of 2000 copies. 500 copies will be sold through the publishers' networks of stores. The remaining 1500 copies will be sold for MB&F and its partners, in a special protective box made of the same high-density foam used to package MB&F timepieces. watches.name: Vulcain Nautical Legacy Massena LAB
watches.description: Introducing The Vulcain Nautical Legacy Massena LAB, a 1950s-inspired diver’s watch with a rich, brown dial; redesigned, vintage-inspired hands; and a brand new, Massena-LAB-designed black rubber bracelet. Powered by an in-house movement, the Vulcain Nautical Legacy Massena LAB retains all of the rugged, technical know-how of the original Vulcain Cricket Nautical, one of the very-first diver’s watches with an alarm that could be heard underwater. The original Cricket Nautical was released in 1961, the result of research conducted by three passionate divers: Hannes Keller, a Swiss deep-sea diving pioneer as well as a physicist and mathematician, Max-Yves Brandily, the explorer and filmmaker, and Arthur Droz, a national certified diving instructor. In 1966, Hannes Keller wore a Cricket Nautical in a record-setting dive reaching an extreme depth of almost 250 meters. The legendary Jacques Cousteau, acting as Keller’s witness, recorded and validated Keller’s record. The Vulcain Nautical Legacy Massena LAB ponders “What would the Cricket Nautical look like today if it had been created a decade earlier, in the 1950s?” To start, the dial has been recolored a rich, chocolate brown, which shimmers subtly in the light, inspired by some of Massena LAB’s favorite vintage, tropical dials. The hands, which have been completely redesigned and are unique to this Massena LAB collaboration include a baton-style hand for hours, large arrowhead for the minutes, and a red arrow alarm hand. The hands are filled with beige lume, with matching lume plots on the dial, and glow green in low light or dark water for maximum legibility and echo the watch’s vintage inspiration by mimicking the period-correct tritium. The black rubber strap, designed by Massena LAB and fitted with a Vulcain logo stainless steel buckle, is comfortable and practical in and out of the water whether you are wearing a wetsuit or sitting at your desk. The double dial features a decompression table, which is revealed through an aperture on the dial. To set it correctly, the wearer must first determine the length and depth of the intended dive, using the crown at 4 o’clock to rotate the dial’s upper plate. When used correctly, the scale which is revealed by the aperture, shows the diver for how many minutes they must stop at nine, six, and three meters before returning to the surface. The stainless steel case, measuring 42mm, features a closed “triple case back” which acts as a resonance chamber and allows for the alarm to be loud enough to be heard underwater, alerting the diver that they should start their ascent. The watch is powered by the manual-wound Cricket Alarm Calibre V10, with a frequency of 18,000 vibrations per hour (2.5 Hz) and a power reserve of 52 hours. The in-house caliber has two barrels: one is the energy source for timekeeping, while the other powers the alarm function. Both barrels are charged by turning the crown at three o’clock: clockwise for timekeeping and counterclockwise for the alarm system. The Vulcain Nautical Legacy Massena LAB is a limited edition of only 25 pieces. Free shipping.

watches.name: UNIMATIC x King Nerd x Massena LAB U4S-BRZ-SI
watches.description: Massena LAB is pleased to announce the UNIMATIC U4S-BRZ-SI, a three-way collaboration between Italian watchmakers UNIMATIC; British designer, artist, and master engraver King Nerd; and Massena LAB. The U4S-BRZ-SI commemorates the story of William Tell, the Swiss folk hero thought to be the originator of the Swiss Confederation. The U4S-BRZ-SI, or “Swiss Tell”, features a bronze dial covered by a layer of black galvanic coating. When engraved by King Nerd, the black coating is etched away to reveal the gold tones of the original bronze underneath. The dial depicts three elements of the William Tell folk legend. At the center of the dial, the apple represents not only the literal fruit from the Tell story, but also The Big Apple — New York City — home to both Massena LAB and the Swiss Institute. The arrows, piercing the apple, function as the dial’s hour marks while also symbolizing precision, forward-movement, and progress. The bounds of ribbon, the loose blindfold of Tell’s rescued son, is a symbol of freedom, liberation, and the opposite of blindness: vision, wisdom, and knowledge. The story of the U4S-BRZ-SI, however, does not end with its dial—the heart of any watch is its movement, and the watch is powered by a Swiss-made caliber. Of course, this is only fitting for a watch conceived to celebrate Swiss history and culture. The U4S-BRZ-SI is a pièce unique , conceived and created for the Swiss Institutes’ “Time for Art” auction. The watch was not commercialized or reproduced.

watches.name: H. Moser & Cie. x Massena LAB Endeavour Chronograph
watches.description: Massena LAB is proud to partner with Swiss independent watchmaker H. Moser & Cie. on the release of the Endeavour Chronograph, a stainless steel wristwatch which honors the spirit of exploration, discovery, and innovation which has long characterized H. Moser & Cie. Finding design inspiration in historic Moser chronographs from the 1940s, the Endeavour Chronograph has a classic dual register dial configuration. With its two sub-dials at 3 and 9 o'clock, one for the small seconds and the other for the 45-minute chronograph. The presence of a tachymetric scale, which allows the ground speed to be measured with precision, also recalls the practical purpose watches would fulfill for explorers and aviators of the mid-century. Its Funky Blue dial, a true H. Moser & Cie. signature, plays a key role in this aesthetic, along with the Moser logo in its historic form, while all the technical elements, such as the tachymetric scale, the chronometer graduation, the sub-dials and the hands, feature Super-LumiNova® to ensure perfect legibility in any situation. The Endeavour Chronograph, housed in a 41-mm stainless steel case, is paired with a brown kudu leather strap with white stitching. The design of this collaborative piece, created by Massena LAB, steps away slightly from the minimalist philosophy usually associated with H. Moser & Cie. However, it faithfully respects the aesthetic of the 1940s, striking a perfect balance between tradition and contemporary boldness. Limited edition of 100 pieces. Limit of one watch per household.

watches.name: Albishorn x Massena LAB Maxigraph
watches.description: Massena LAB is proud to partner with the new independent watchmaker Albishorn for the release of a new collaborative timepiece, the Maxigraph, a monopusher chronograph —and a true tool watch with a patented regatta timer—inspired by the rich history of nautical timepieces and of the city of Geneva itself. Recalling the first edition of the now legendary regatta race, Le Bol d’Or , first held on Lake Geneva in 1939, the Maxigraph is the creation of an imagined history: how might a modern-day regatta chronograph have looked in the 1930s? Albishorn is an independent Swiss watchmaker that blends (and bends) horological history to craft original and distinctive timepieces, drawing inspiration from vintage pieces to create what it calls " imaginary vintage®". The Maxigraph imagines what might have been, if horological history had been only slightly different. The Maxigraph is a monopusher chronograph with an automatic, Swiss-made, proprietary caliber with a patented ten-minute retrograde regatta timer. Unlike a typical regatta timer, which restarts endlessly when the countdown is over, the Maxigraph’s timer stops once ten minutes have elapsed, while the chronograph continues to run. The countdown is reset by pushing its single, red aluminum pusher at 9 o’clock, the optimal position for the thumb, considered the best digit when operating a chronograph. The silver dial of the Maxigraph was designed with a focus on legibility and functionality. Each scale has its own place, finish, and color, resulting in an original and modern sector dial which references the timepieces of the 1930s. An aperture for a colorful running indicator is located at four o’clock, and Super-LumiNova ® provides luminosity to the hour and minute hands. Super-LumiNova ® is also integrated subtly on the dial on two scales during hours when low light is typical: one arc spanning from 18 to 24 o’clock, and another from 12 to 6 o’clock. The stainless steel case of the Maxigraph measures 39mm, or 41mm including its stainless steel, bidirectional bezel. Its crown is located at 10 o’clock, remaining clear of obstructions, and the watch is water-resistant to 100 meters, making it a perfect companion for a day on the water. The Albishorn x Massena LAB Maxigraph is now sold out and no longer available for purchase. To be notified of future Massena LAB collaborations with Albishorn, please join our waiting list or sign up for our newsletter.

watches.name: Phillips in Association with Bacs & Russo 1952 Observatory Dial Limited Edition by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès
watches.description: Phillips in Association with Bacs & Russo is delighted to introduce its latest collaborative horological creation: the 1952 Observatory Dial Limited Edition. This exquisite vintage-inspired wristwatch is the result of a creative partnership between Phillips Watches leadership, William Massena of Massena LAB, and the masterful touch of award-winning independent watchmaker Raúl Pagès. The dial finds inspiration from the Observatory-grade Patek Philippe Ref. 2458 wristwatch, a unique masterpiece crafted in platinum for the distinguished collector and lawyer Joe Ben “J.B.” Champion, Jr. in 1952. Notably, when this unique vintage wristwatch last sold publicly at auction in 2014, it set a record for the most valuable time-only wristwatch ever sold at auction, cementing its place in history. Despite its historic influences, this collaboration remains profoundly modern, building on the technical platform first established by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès in 2022, with the successful release of their Magraph Limited Edition wristwatch. The result is the all-new 1952 Observatory Dial Limited Edition, featuring a 38.5mm × 10mm case made of 316L stainless steel, and with the manual-wind, proprietary caliber M690 ticking inside. The impressive caliber M690 is an iteration of Massena LAB’s first movement — but here with small seconds at 9 o’clock — and features an impressive level of traditional hand-decoration, which is achieved by a network of Swiss craftsmen whose work is overseen by Pagès himself. Pagès also designed and conceived the overall architecture of the movement, but he does not personally handle the production or decoration of the movement like he would in one of his own watches. This is the caliber M690’s first-ever appearance in a publicly released wristwatch. Our collective love for vintage watches and the stories woven around them served as our guide in creating the 1952 Observatory Dial Limited Edition. Crucially, this admiration didn’t confine our creative process and exploration; rather, it empowered it. That is the reason we opted for a two-tone grey dial with yellow gold accents found throughout the pearl-style minute track, the handset (hour, minute, small seconds), and the hour markers (Arabic numerals for six and 12 o’clock, batons used for the remaining). The cool-tone grey-and-gold color scheme lends a slightly more contemporary aesthetic compared to the traditional Observatory Dial format. The 1952 Observatory Dial Limited Edition wristwatch has been produced in an exclusive run of exactly 99 timepieces in stainless steel. All watches will be available for purchase exclusively through Phillips, for CHF 8,800. Price: CHF 8,800.

watches.name: UNIMATIC U5S-ML24
watches.description: If you have reached this page, then you are a friend of Massena LAB. Massena LAB is proud to introduce you to the friends-and-family exclusive version of our latest release with UNIMATIC based on a completely new model , the Modello Cinque , which, for the first time for UNIMATIC features a 36mm case. A companion piece to the U5S-ML, the UNIMATIC x Massena LAB U5S-ML24, is an insiders-only, limited edition of 99 pieces with a GMT function and is not available to the general public. Like the U5S-ML, the U5S-ML24 features a 36mm case, which places the watch firmly in the midsize and unisex categories, whose discreet case size compliments a diverse range of wrists. The U5S-ML24 is a discreet travel watch, whose size, subtle profile, and GMT function make it ideal for international journeys. Like its companion piece, the aesthetic of the U5S-ML24 is inspired by German mid-century industrial design, like the work of Dieter Rams , as well as vintage automobile dashboards dating to the 1960s and 70s. Its clean lines and minimalist dial can be appreciated by anyone who values good design and practicality. The matte black dial features glossy white indices; a yellow GMT hand with matching yellow 24 hour markers, and can be dressed up or dressed down to taste. The overall design aesthetic perfectly matches its 36mm brushed stainless steel case, which feels simultaneously classic yet modern. On its case back: a custom UNIMATIC x Massena LAB world time motif as well as a limited-edition number out of 99. The Modello Cinque U5S-ML24 is powered by the Swiss-made, self-winding ETA caliber 2893-2, with 21 jewels, a frequency of 28,800bph (4Hz), 42 hours of power reserve, GMT function, and a hacking seconds hand. Fitted with a black tapered TPU strap, the U5S-ML24 is delivered with two strap options, both with quick release: a tapered TPU strap in black, as well as a tapered TPU strap in straw yellow to match the dial's yellow details. Each example is presented in a branded UNIMATIC x Massena LAB tough case with a warranty card and unique ID seal. Limited edition of 99 for Massena LAB Friends and Family only. Free shipping. Limit of one watch per household.

watches.name: UNIMATIC U5S-ML
watches.description: Massena LAB is proud to announce our latest collaboration, and an entirely new model from UNIMATIC, the Modello Cinque U5S-ML, which, for the first time for UNIMATIC features a 36mm case. This smaller case size places the watch firmly in the midsize and unisex categories, allowing for the watch to be enjoyed by a wide audience of collectors while complimenting a wide range of wrist sizes. Giovanni Moro, UNIMATIC co-founder and co-designer, explains: “The newly designed Modello Cinque, the first UNIMATIC watch to measure 36mm, incorporates all of what we like best about smaller diameter watches. The case features a large dial opening with an angled rehaut ; which, when combined with oversized crown and curved lugs, creates a case profile that is both comfortable and flattering to a variety of wrist sizes. Many other subtle design details combine to produce a balanced and nuanced watch, which aims to blend in rather than stand out.” The dial of the U5S-ML is inspired by German mid-century industrial design, especially the work of Dieter Rams , as well as vintage Bavarian automobile dashboards dating to the 1960s and 70s. The Modello Cinque U5S-ML's clean lines and minimalist dial can be appreciated by anyone who values good design and practicality. The sleek dial, which features simple and elegant, glossy white markers set against a matte black surface, can be dressed up or dressed down according to taste. The overall design aesthetic perfectly matches its 36mm brushed stainless steel case, which feels simultaneously classic yet modern. Turning the watch over, the case back features a custom UNIMATIC x Massena LAB Fibonacci Sequence motif and is individually numbered out of 300. The Modello Cinque U5S-ML is powered by the Swiss-made, self-winding Sellita SW200-1, with 26 jewels, a frequency of 28,800bph (4Hz), 41 hours of power reserve, and a hacking seconds hand. Fitted with a black tapered TPU strap, the U5S-ML Limited Edition includes an alternate tapered TPU strap, in the same straw yellow tone which can be found on the tip of the dial’s second hand, for added versatility. Each example is presented in a branded UNIMATIC x Massena LAB tough case with a warranty card and unique ID seal. Free shipping. Limit of one watch per household.

watches.name: Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Chronograph '68
watches.description: Introducing the Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Chronograph 68', a limited-edition, Swiss-made, self-winding chronograph with a black, vintage inspired dial. From the carefree and music-filled streets of Swinging London, to Arthur Ashe’s triumph at the U.S. Open, or Graham Hill at the Formula One, 1968 represents a year of important societal and cultural change in world history. The Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Chronograph ’68 is inspired by a number of vintage references produced and sold in the late 1960s. The Chronograph ’68 features a handsome, black dial with reflective hour markers; three colorful registers in red, white, and blue; an eccentric lollipop chronograph hand; and a uni-directional, 120-click bezel with a luminous plot at zero. Its hour, minute, and chronograph hands are also luminous. Housed inside its 41mm, stainless steel case, the Chronograph ’68 is powered by the Swiss-made, self-winding Landeron caliber 73, beating at a frequency of 28,800 half oscillations per hour (4Hz) with 43 hours of power reserve. The Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Chronograph ’68 will be delivered in a Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB presentation box which will include a warranty card, instructions, and a guarantee of two years. Limited edition of 99. Free, express shipping.

watches.name: Massena LAB Archetype 1.0
watches.description: Introducing the Massena LAB Archetype 1.0, a friends-and-family-exclusive limited-edition chronograph with vintage styling and an eye-catching, champagne dial. The Archetype 1.0 is the successor to the Archetype 0.0 , a vintage-inspired chronograph with a gilt dial released in 2021. The dial of the Archetype 1.0 is inspired by some of our favorite chronographs from the mid-century. The champagne dial, which changes color depending on the light from pale salmon to ivory, features applied, rhodium-plated Arabic numerals and navy blue indices. At the center of the dial is a prominent, escargot style spiral tachymeter. The dial has two subdials: at 6 o'clock, a thirty-minute counter; and at 9 o'clock, the small seconds. For increased legibility, the hands are color-coordinated for timekeeping or chronograph functions. Stainless steel hands are employed for hours, minutes, and seconds, while the chronograph and the thirty-minute counter hands are blued steel. The Archetype 1.0 measures 42mm and is cased in stainless steel, which is both polished and brushed for visual interest. The watch features a double-domed sapphire crystal. The watch is powered by the Swiss-made, manual-wound, Sellita caliber SW510 with 58 hours of power reserve. The Archetype 1.0 is fitted with Italian-made, Saffiano leather watch straps and a Swiss-made, stainless steel Massena LAB buckle. Limited to only 50 pieces. A Massena LAB friends and family exclusive. Limit of one watch per household. Free shipping.

watches.name: Chronograph Monopoussoir Sylvain Pinaud x Massena LAB
watches.description: We are proud to announce our first collaboration with independent watchmaker Sylvain Pinaud, the Chronograph Monopoussoir Sylvain Pinaud x Massena LAB, a handcrafted monopusher chronograph, which is limited to only ten pieces. Years before his win at the 2022 GPHG (Grand Prix d’Horlogerie de Genève), where he was awarded that year’s “Horological Revelation” Prize, Sylvain Pinaud crossed paths with William Massena at a collectors event in Geneva. Pinaud's avant-garde monopusher chronograph, cased in titanium, instantly caught Massena's imagination. Reflecting on their first meeting, Massena recalls: "When I held Sylvain's chronograph, it was pure magic. Hearing Sylvain recount the timepiece’s origin story—and how he had crafted it to compete in the prestigious Meilleurs Ouvriers de France (MOF) competition—only sealed the deal. If you live outside of France, you may not be familiar with the MOF, but inside France, it is famous. About every four years, a competition is held to honor the best of the nation’s craftspeople, or ouvriers, in French. Entrants compete in various categories ranging from the culinary arts to metal and stoneworking. When Sylvain won his MOF with his Chronograph Monopoussoir, it almost instantly elevated him to his place among today’s most talented and exciting independent watchmakers. His win at the GPHG in 2022 only cemented this position." After seeing the watch in the metal, William asked Sylvain if he could place an order for himself but with a revised case design. What started as a personal commission turned into a professional project when many of Massena’s friends in the collector community expressed interest in acquiring a similar watch from Pinaud. The spark of collaboration ignited, and the Chronograph Monopoussoir Sylvain Pinaud x Massena LAB was born. From a personal muse to a shared project, Pinaud's ingenuity and Massena's vision coalesced into horological artistry. Technical marvel meets aesthetic elegance in this timepiece, crafted almost entirely by hand in the atelier of Sylvain Pinaud in Sainte-Croix, Switzerland. The watch is powered by a hand-wound movement with a fully integrated, column-wheel chronograph with a horizontal clutch, which can be started; paused; and reset using a single pusher located discreetly at the crown. The movement’s integrated chronograph complication, hand-finished by the watchmaker himself, is left exposed on the dial side and is a delight to observe. The dial, created by Comblémine SA—the dial manufacture owned by the renowned watchmaker Kari Voutilainen—is a fusion of modern design with vintage aesthetics inspired by maritime chronometers. Sapphire windows on the sides of the titanium case, as well as a sapphire caseback, invite glances of the dial and of the movement from almost every angle—a glimpse into the careful labor and artistry which characterize a Sylvain Pinaud timepiece. The watch is fitted with a strap by Jean Rousseau Paris in aged calfskin with a crocodile lining. The Chronograph Monopoussoir Sylvain Pinaud x Massena LAB is limited to ten pieces, with production limited to three pieces each year. Price: CHF 130,000.

watches.name: Massena LAB x Revolution Uni-Racer 1949
watches.description: We are excited to announce our latest project, and our first with Revolution Magazine: the Massena LAB x Revolution Uni-Racer 1949. This collaboration was born of a friendship— that between William Massena and Wei Koh, founder of Revolution—and of their mutual appreciation of vintage watches, especially stainless steel chronographs from the mid-century. Vintage-enthusiasts and connoisseurs will observe that the dial of the Massena LAB x Revolution Uni-Racer 1949 is inspired by one such watch: a completely unobtainable pièce unique dating to 1949. The Uni-Racer 1949 is a Swiss-made chronograph with a glossy, black dial, vintage styling, and an eye-catching sector track with Roman numerals in raised Super-LumiNova. The color of the lume was developed specifically for this dial, and while it is an exact color match to the vintage model, its glow is far brighter. The hour and minute hands are blued steel and also luminous, while the chronograph hand and subdial hands are white, matching the dial’s indices and tachymeter. Inside the Uni-Racer 1949 is the Swiss-made, hand-wound Sellita caliber SW510 M Elaboré, with 58 hours of power reserve, and a 4Hz vibrational rate. The stainless steel case has a diameter of 39mm, and a thickness of 13mm, including its crystal. The anti-scratch acrylic crystal is produced in Switzerland by Kyburz et Cie and is faithful to the vintage styling of the Uni-Racer 1949. On its closed case back: the M LAB signature is engraved within Revolution’s star logo. Each watch is engraved “One of 120”. Limited-edition of 120 pieces .

watches.name: Le Chronographe Monopoussoir Louis Erard x Massena LAB - Rhodium
watches.description: We are proud to present our newest collaboration with Louis Erard, Le Chronographe Monopoussoir Louis Erard x Massena LAB in two variants: Rhodium and Gold . Further developing up on the aesthetics established in our first collaboration with Louis Erard, the dial of Le Chrono Monopoussoir is inspired by marine chronometers dating to the late 18th and early 19th centuries, especially those by Ferdinand Berthoud and Antide Janvier. Le Chronographe Monopoussoir Louis Erard x Massena LAB is a monopusher chronograph, showing hours and minutes, and a thirty-minute counter at 12 o'clock. The outer sector ring is rhodium-plated and circularly grained, and its counter is silvered opaline, creating an attractive contrast against the frosted texture of the main dial. Le Chronographe Monopoussoir Louis Erard x Massena LA B has a polished, stainless steel with a diameter of 43mm, fitted with a sapphire crystal. The watch is fitted with black, calfskin leather straps with quick-release functionality and is delivered in a Louis Erard presentation box with a warranty card and certificate of authenticity. watches.name: Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Mergulhador Skin Diver
watches.description: Introducing the Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Mergulhador Skin Diver, a reincarnation of the vintage, original Merghulador dive watch, first introduced by Mathey-Tissot in the 1970s. Originally designed and produced for both military and civilian use in the Portuguese market, the Mathey-Tissot Merghulador ( Merghulador in Portuguese translates to "diver" in English) has, over the years, become a favorite among collectors and enthusiasts of vintage dive watches. The amber dial of the Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Mergulhador is, in fact, inspired by a watch from William Massena's personal collection and is exclusive to this collaboration. watches.name: Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Type XX Flyback Chronograph
watches.description: Introducing the Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Type XX Flyback Chronograph, one of two vintage-inspired chronographs both honoring one of the great tool watches of mid-century aviation, released in collaboration with famed, Swiss watchmaker Mathey-Tissot. In the 1950s and 60s, several prominent manufacturers, like Breguet, were issued contracts by the French Ministry of Defense (MOD) to produce pilot’s watches according to certain military specifications. The requirements included a flyback function, or retour en vol , which allowed a pilot to instantaneously restart a running chronograph without the typical need to stop, reset, and then restart; a black dial with large, luminous, Arabic numerals and two registers at 3 and 9 o’clock; a bidirectional, 12-hour rotation bezel; and a power reserve of at least 35 hours. When Breguet, based in France at the time, lacked the resources to complete the contract on their own, they turned to their partner in Switzerland, Mathey-Tissot. Mathey-Tissot was the one of the most industrious suppliers of the Type 20 chronograph of the post war era, supplying a great number of the chronographs to the French government. In fact, out of the 2,000 Type 20 chronographs that Breguet had agreed to supply, none were made by Breguet. They were, instead, made by Mathey-Tissot. The Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Type XX Flyback Chronograph features a clean, black dial with large, coffee-colored Arabic numerals, painted with soft layers of lume and two registers: a “big eye” thirty-minute counter at 3 o’clock, and small seconds at 9. This dial is exclusive to Massena LAB. The Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Type XX Flyback Chronograph is the companion piece to the Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Type XX Tribute Chronograph . The Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Type XX Flyback Chronograph is powered by the self-winding Arola caliber 7750 FlyB, so-named for its flyback complication, with a power reserve of 48 hours, and 29 jewels. The Mathey-Tissot x Massena LAB Type XX Flyback Chronograph is limited to 25 pieces and is available immediately. Free, express shipping.

watches.name: Magraph by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès
watches.description: W e are proud to present the Magraph by Massena LAB and Raúl Pagès, our first collaboration with Ra ú l Pagès, and his first ever with another brand. The release of the Magraph marks the beginning of a new chapter for Massena LAB. The Magraph features, for the first time ever, a Massena LAB proprietary movement: the M660, d esigned by Raúl Pagès in Switzerland. The M660 is a manual-winding, 4Hz movement, with a power reserve of 60 hours, and 21 jewels. The M660 features a handsome, broad plate with Côtes de Genève finishing and hand-chamfered anglage on its plates and bridges, all of which is visible through its exhibition caseback. Tucked under its balance wheel is the hidden mark of Raúl Pagès: " L a tortue ," or tortoise. Surrounding this stamped signature, or poinçon Pagès , are overlapping decorative circles or perlage . This degree of movement finishing demonstrates a level of artistry and skill that is more akin to a luxury timepiece three times its price. The dial of the Magraph is inspired by Bauhaus art and design of the 1930s, which favors simple geometric shapes against elaborate ornamentation. The watch is minimal, precise, but expressive. The dial is a subtle off-white, with a rhodium-plated and circularly-rained outermost sector ring. The dial is then intersected with a radially grooved small-seconds subsidiary dial at 6 o'clock. The case of the Magraph is inspired by dress watches of the 1930s and 40s and is made of 316L stainless, measuring 38.5mm. Happily, the case features an exhibition case back, allowing the M660 to be admired through a layer of non-reflective, Sapphire crystal. watches.name: Habring² x Massena LAB CFP
watches.description: Introducing the Habring² x Massena LAB Chrono Felix Perpetual, or LAB-CFP, a monopusher chronograph and perpetual calendar featuring the all new, in-house Habring² caliber A11CP. The dial of the Habring² x Massena LAB-CFP is inspired by the Patek Philippe reference 1518, an almost legendary perpetual calendar chronograph first introduced in the 1940s and a “grail watch” among the most determined collectors to this very day. Connoisseurs will feel the influence of the 1518 particularly strongly in the use of applied, Arabic numerals for the hour markers on the dial of the Massena LAB-CFP. The monochromatic, black-and-steel dial of the LAB-CFP takes its conceptual inspiration from another medium: photography, and specifically film negatives. When developing a photograph using a negative, the brightest areas of the negative will, once fully processed, appear the darkest. This is the concept of the LAB-CFP, and the result is a striking, high-contrast, and easily legible dial. The LAB-CFP is a monopusher chronograph perpetual calendar which displays hours and minutes, day of the week (at 3 o’clock), month and leap year indicator (at 6), day of the month (at 9) and moonphase and chronograph thirty minute counter (at 12). The LAB-CFP is powered by an all-new, in-house caliber from Habring²: the manual-winding A11CP. This combination of a monopusher chronograph and a perpetual calendar is both a rare combination and a technical feat. When considering the small size of the caliber’s footprint, fitting inside a case diameter of only 38.5mm, this is an impressive technical achievement for an independent manufacture. Production is extremely limited, and delivery is to be confirmed on a case-by-case basis. Limit of one watch per household.

watches.name: Massena LAB Geometer
watches.description: If you have arrived at this page, then you are a friend of Massena LAB, and we are proud to share with you the results of our latest experiment. A private release, and a passion project, our newest project reflects our admiration of vintage watches, especially those from the midcentury. The Massena LAB Geometer is a reincarnation of a little-known, vintage chronograph, the Rodania Geometer, which has long been considered something of a grail watch for a niche of vintage watch enthusiasts and collectors. Notoriously difficult to find, and even more so to acquire, vintage examples can fetch prices in the high double digits at auction, making the watch all the more inaccessible to a larger audience. The original Rodania Geometer reference, while closely resembling another famous Swiss chronograph, dates to 1954, three full years before the release of its doppelgänger, the Omega Speedmaster®. Little else is known about the genesis of the watch, and while the company exists to this day, journalistic outreach to Rodania has not proved fruitful as the company has seemingly not responded for comment. Like many other Swiss manufactures (and in this case, Belgian) its ownership has changed hands over the years, and sadly, the company no longer resembles its former self. The Massena LAB Geometer is a vintage-styled chronograph with a tropical dial, distinctively wide and sharp hour and minute hands, three registers, and cream lume on its hands and hour indicators. The Geometer is fitted inside a 39mm polished stainless steel case with brushed lugs for visual interest. Its three sunken subdials, which are radially grooved, include a thirty-minute counter at 3 o’clock, twelve-hour counter at 6, and small seconds counter at 9. The Geometer uses a domed, acrylic crystal, with the addition of an engraved and stylized “M” at its center. This small, but important, detail, while difficult to manufacture, is a meaningful nod to the original, and now vintage, models. We are releasing the Massena LAB Geometer as a time-limited edition, available for purchase until March 30, 2022, by invitation only, with a maximum quantity of 99 pieces to be produced. Delivery is expected in September 2022. Free express worldwide shipping.

watches.name: Old School by Massena LAB and Luca Soprana
watches.description: Massena LAB is proud to announce the release of Old School , our first collaboration with independent watchmaker Luca Soprana. Old School is a concept watch that began as both an experiment and a study of an aspect of watchmaking previously unexplored by Massena LAB — the montre d’école . A traditional montre d’école , translating literally to “school watch”, is a watch that is designed and crafted by an apprentice watchmaker at the conclusion of their studies. The finished montre d’école is then evaluated to determine whether or not the apprentice may call themselves a true watchmaker. Some montres d’école are finished so elaborately that they require a full year of work to complete, and the most talented apprentice-watchmakers create their own movements. It is this attention to detail, dedication, and savoir-faire that is the essence of Old School . For Old School , Luca Soprana revisits the concept of a montre d’école , twenty years into his career as a master watchmaker. A second, important influence on Old School can be found in the movement’s finishings, which are typical of the style found in high, German watchmaking. Examining the movement, a keen eye will observe the sober but meticulous work required of traits-tirés or straight-grain finishing, dotted with shining gold chatons. The movement of Old School is characterized by a broad, three-quarter plate and is constructed entirely of maillechort, or German silver. It includes a blued steel balance spring, a swan-neck regulator with a micro-metrical screw, a bi-metallic balance wheel, and black-mirror finished pallet and escapement bridges. The movement is signed “Massena & L. Soprana” and is engraved with its limited edition number. The dial of Old School was designed by William Massena and combines several aesthetic influences, including the classic marine chronometers of the late 18th century, especially those by Ferdinand Berthoud, and the sector dials of many chronometer wristwatches — an influence that has been previously explored by Massena LAB in our collaborations with Habring². Made entirely by hand, the dial of Old School is made entirely of maillechort, which is then plated with rhodium. At its center, the dial is hand-frosted and then plated with gold. A subdial at 9 o’clock, for the seconds, is signed, in midnight blue, with both “Massena & Co.” and “Vaumarcus”, for the castle in Switzerland where Soprana operates his atelier and where Old School is made. The hands of Old School are hand-filed blued steel. The crown is also carefully made by hand. Old School features a 41.5mm case in polished and brushed stainless steel, with a thickness of 11mm including the sapphire crystal, which covers both the dial and the display back. Old School is fitted with an exclusive, midnight blue alligator strap by Jean Rousseau Paris with a stainless steel tang buckle.

Shapiro and, for the first time ever, official Chronometer Certification from the Horological Society of New York. The dial of the LAB03 was designed by William Massena and hand-crafted by Joshua Shapiro in his Los Angeles workshop. The tone of the dial, which shifts from salmon to rose depending on the light, is the natural color of the bronze metal and is not the result of painting or plating as is common practice. The dial of the LAB03 is J.N. Shapiro’s first dial to utilize bronze. J.N. Shapiro uses an eighty-year-old straight-line guilloché machine to achieve the striking basketweave pattern, a centuries-old and arduous process which few dial makers will attempt today. The outer ring of the dial is then grained using Water of Ayr stone, a traditional watchmaking tool which is exceedingly rare today. The markings on the dial, along with the hands, are a deep midnight blue, providing excellent legibility against the bronze metal. The leather strap of the LAB03 is made in Italy from deerskin, also in a deep blue tone. The ERWIN LAB03 is made in Austria by Habring² with their in-house caliber A11MS hand-wound movement, featuring a patented deadbeat seconds complication. Turning the timepiece over reveals the movement, visible through a display back of sapphire crystal. The movement of the LAB03 has a unique and special finishing: it is first plated with a layer of rhodium, followed by a second layer of 5N rose gold. The LAB03 is the first watch to receive official Chronometer Certification from the Horological Society of New York, America’s first watchmaking guild. A keen eye will observe that the movement of the LAB03 has been stamped with the official HSNY Seal. Chronometer Certification from the HSNY indicates that a timepiece has met its rigorous testing protocols and has exceeded the international standards outlined in ISO 3159. Watches that pass the HSNY’s visual rate testing procedures are issued a physical certificate detailing that individual timepiece’s results, which is included with your delivery of the LAB03. The Habring² ERWIN LAB03 will be produced in a limited edition of 66 pieces to commemorate 1866, the year the Horological Society of New York was founded. The LAB03 will be shipped in batches monthly, beginning in late January 2022. Bronze develops a unique patina whenever it is exposed to oxygen, and the dial of LAB03 will change in color over time. This patina is natural and will vary depending on the climate of the region where the watch is worn.

watches.name: Habring² x Massena LAB ERWIN LAB01
watches.description: On its dial, the Massena LAB x Habring ² ERWIN LAB01 is a simple, three hand timepiece with a deep black sector dial. The 38.5 mm bronze case is polished with a concave bezel that frames a sector dial the that recalls the legendary sector dials from the 1930s. The sector dial is divided into four concentric segments. The markings and numerals of each segment are raised and finished in gold for depth. Another particularity of the dial is that the outer railway five-minute divisions are perfectly aligned with the jumping seconds hand. The feuille hands are finished in gold. Altogether, the high contrast of the gold elements against the deep black dial results in optimal legibility. Turning the timepiece over is a further delight with a display back that reveals the workings of the fully in-house caliber A11MS movement. Thanks to its patented architecture, the locking mechanism is mounted under a three-spoke bridge that puts the jumping seconds mechanism at center stage. Every jumping second captivates the eye and can be enjoyed on both sides of the timepiece. Completing the sophisticated design, Habring ² ERWIN LAB01 is fitted with a handmade Italian leather strap.

watches.name: UNIMATIC U1-ML6
watches.description: Born from the idea of “What would a UNIMATIC watch from the 1950s look like today,” the U1-ML6 began as a conversation between the two companies on how to create a high-quality wristwatch that felt modern and incorporated vintage touchpoints, while not relying on nostalgia alone. Housed inside the 41.5mm stainless steel case of the U1-ML6 is the automatic caliber Seiko NH35A 21600bph, with a power reserve of 41 hours. The watch features a classic black bezel with a red triangle, reminiscent of the Rolex 6538, made famous by Sean Connery as James Bond in Goldfinger. The 15-minute marker on the bezel is the first time that UNIMATIC has featured it on one of its watches. Turning the 120-click unidirectional bezel is both an audible and tactile treat; the bezel hangs slightly over the diameter of the watch, making it easier to turn as well. Turning the watch over, the viewer is treated to a detailed engraving of the Greek god, Poseidon. Aside from the reference to the god of the sea, the engraving pays tribute to World War II veteran Alastair Robertson, an officer in the British Royal Navy. Before his retirement, he served as the navigator for the aircraft carrier HMS Ocean, the ship’s crest was that of Poseidon.

watches.name: MB&F x L'Epée 1839 x Massena LAB T-Rex Bronze
watches.description: Straddling time from the ancient to the immediate, T-Rex Bronze creates a harmonious balance between mechanical and organic forms. This model switches out the original steel for bronze, the copper alloy whose mastery amounted to a technological revolution so immense that it ushered in a new age of early civilization. The feet of the T-Rex Bronze are aged to create an earthy brown patina, and the entire bronze structure is oxidized by hand to “lock in time” its color and the unique characteristics of the material. This individual patination and stabilization means that no two clocks are alike.

watches.name: Massena LAB Archetype 0.0
watches.description: What is the Archetype 0.0? The product of a laboratory experiment, resulting in an exclusive set of pre-series prototypes, available only to our friends and family and not to the public. Fitted in a sleek case of brushed and polished stainless steel, the black, glossy dial of the 0.0 is detailed with warm, gold markings, achieved only by recreating the same, traditional gilt techniques as those used in mid-century dial making. The Archetype 0.0 features a deerskin leather strap in cognac brown with a signed, stainless steel tang buckle. Made in Switzerland.

watches.name: MING x Massena LAB 17.09 Honey
watches.description: Massena LAB is proud to present the 17.09 MING x Massena LAB, our first collaboration with MING, and MING’s first collaboration with any other brand. This collaboration marks a partnership between two friends and colleagues: renowned photographer and watchmaker Ming Thein and William Massena. The MING x Massena LAB features an intricate, hexagonal honeycomb dial inspired by vintage Rolex dials of the mid-century. Surrounding the central honeycomb is a circularly-brushed ring to compliment its patterned center. The hours, which appear to float above the dial, are etched into the underside of the crystal and filled with Super-LumiNova for increased visibility in low light. MING and Massena LAB logos are placed at three and nine o’clock. The case of the 17.09 MING x Massena LAB is constructed from polished and brushed 316L stainless steel, which recalls the “padellone” (or “little frying pan” in Italian) cases of the Rolex 8171. At 38mm, and with the same distinctive flared lugs of the 17.09, the MING x Massena LAB will fit a variety of wrist sizes comfortably with straps by Jean Rousseau Paris. On its reverse side, the honeycomb pattern is etched to encircle the Massena LAB logo. The 17.09 MING x Massena LAB is powered by a modified version of the Sellita SW330-2, the 330.M1. Developed by Schwarz-Etienne, it features an independent hour hand adjustment mechanism, exclusive to the MING 17.09, which makes it an ideal travel watch. Limited edition of 50 pieces.
